about: Twenty claims taken from old AI-style answers. Ten are known to have changed since the answer was written; ten are known to be unchanged. Each item stores the evidence sentence the checker is judged against, with the source it came from, so the run can be repeated offline and checked by hand. The live path in app/stale.py uses the same checker with sources fetched at check time.

items.answer: Our solar system has 9 planets.
items.evidence_text: The Solar System has eight planets: Mercury, Venus, Earth, Mars, Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus and Neptune.
items.note: The IAU reclassified Pluto in 2006; a 2020 answer saying 9 is wrong today.

items.answer: The world's population is 7 billion people.
items.evidence_text: The world population reached 8.2 billion in 2024, according to United Nations estimates.
items.note: World population passed 8 billion in November 2022.

items.answer: India's population is 1.38 billion.
items.evidence_text: India's population was estimated at 1.45 billion in 2024.
items.note: UN estimates put India at about 1.45 billion in 2024.

items.answer: The European Union has 28 member countries.
items.evidence_text: The European Union has 27 member countries since the United Kingdom left on 31 January 2020.
items.note: The United Kingdom left the EU on 31 January 2020.

items.answer: The euro is the official currency of 19 countries.
items.evidence_text: Croatia adopted the euro on 1 January 2023 and became the 20th of the countries using it.
items.note: Croatia joined the euro on 1 January 2023, taking the count to 20.

items.answer: The latest version of Android is version 12.
items.evidence_text: Android version 16, a newer version of Android, was released on 10 June 2025.
items.note: Several major Android versions have shipped since 12.

items.answer: The deadline for linking PAN with Aadhaar is 31 March 2023.
items.evidence_source_name: Income Tax Department, Government of India
items.evidence_text: The last date for linking PAN and Aadhaar was extended to 30 June 2023.
items.note: The CBDT extended the deadline from 31 March 2023 to 30 June 2023.

items.answer: A first-class Forever stamp costs 58 cents.
items.evidence_text: The price of a first-class Forever stamp rose to 78 cents in July 2025.
items.note: USPS raised the Forever stamp price in steps, reaching 78 cents in July 2025.

items.answer: The James Webb Space Telescope will launch on 18 December 2021.
items.evidence_text: The James Webb Space Telescope was launched on 25 December 2021 from French Guiana.
items.note: The launch slipped from 18 December to 25 December 2021.

items.answer: The Paris Olympics will open on 26 July 2024.
items.evidence_text: The Paris 2024 Olympic Games opened on 26 July 2024.
items.note: The date was right, but the claim still speaks of it as a future event. That is a stale claim, not a changed value.

items.answer: The Burj Khalifa in Dubai is 828 metres tall.
items.evidence_text: The Burj Khalifa in Dubai is 828 metres tall, making it the tallest building in the world.
items.note: The height has not changed.

items.answer: Water boils at 100 degrees Celsius at sea level.
items.evidence_text: At sea level, water boils at 100 degrees Celsius.
items.note: A physical constant at standard pressure.

items.answer: The first Moon landing took place on 20 July 1969.
items.evidence_text: Apollo 11 landed on the Moon on 20 July 1969.
items.note: A historical date; it cannot change.

items.answer: India became independent on 15 August 1947.
items.evidence_text: India became independent on 15 August 1947, ending British rule.
items.note: A historical date; it cannot change.

items.answer: The speed of light in vacuum is 299,792 kilometres per second.
items.evidence_text: The speed of light in a vacuum is exactly 299,792 kilometres per second.
items.note: A defined constant.

items.answer: Mount Everest is 8,848.86 metres high.
items.evidence_text: Mount Everest is 8,848.86 metres high, as measured in 2020.
items.note: The 2020 survey height is still the official figure.

items.answer: The 2016 Olympic Games were held in Rio de Janeiro.
items.evidence_text: The 2016 Summer Olympics were held in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil.
items.note: A historical fact; it cannot change.

items.answer: Python was first released in 1991.
items.evidence_text: Python was first released in 1991 by Guido van Rossum.
items.note: A historical year; it cannot change.

items.answer: An adult human skeleton has 206 bones.
items.evidence_text: An adult human skeleton has 206 bones; babies are born with about 300.
items.note: The adult bone count has not changed.

items.answer: The WHO declared COVID-19 a pandemic on 11 March 2020.
items.evidence_text: The World Health Organization declared COVID-19 a pandemic on 11 March 2020.
items.note: A historical date; it cannot change.

name: StaleBench-20
